title: 44 quart storage boxes
text: 44 quart storage boxes. These are awesome.  Just the right size... meaning you can't over fill them and then be unable to lift them.  There is a gasket inside the edge to help keep critters out and moisture.  The side locks are positive.  The boxes themselves are sturdy, a frosty clear (so you can easily see what you have in there without having to open them).  I will most likely purchase more of these.  They are just a super handy size.  All arrived in perfect condition and quickly (I have prime).  Of course, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Hopefully they stand up to the test of time. I am curious about the gasket and how well it will last.  As I said, I will definitely update if there is any news to report.
